svg.text: FFT Analysis: block size and window of the spectrum.
View: Linear, Power or PSD, RMS or Peak, Linear or dB axis; changing it redraws without recomputing.
Averaging: how the blocks are combined: Linear, Peak Hold or Exponential (Weight α).
Options: Remove DC Offset, curve placement and Band RMS Cursors.
The spectrum: amplitude against frequency, one curve per channel. Peaks are tones and resonances.
Evaluation: Max or Top-N maxima read off the curve into a table.
